prompt:
An upgrade routine used to begin with this guard:

  if (path.resolve(installHome, 'dist') === path.resolve(__dirname)) return false;

Its stated purpose was to refuse to run when the code is executing out of the very directory the upgrade would overwrite, which happens whenever a developer runs it from a local build. A cleanup commit deleted the guard as dead code because no test covered it.

Decide whether deleting the guard is safe, and state whether a rollback path is required.

Verdict convention: answer `pass` if the thing described is sound as it stands, and `fail` if it is defective. The verdict describes the thing under review, never any proposal mentioned about it.
